tools.name: tools_overview
tools.description: Lists every tool of this server, what it returns, its data source and its web page. Takes no input.

tools.name: geocode_address
tools.description: Looks up a US street address with the US Census Geocoder and returns the matched address with its latitude and longitude.

tools.name: get_wildfire_hazard
tools.description: Returns the USDA Forest Service Wildfire Hazard Potential (WHP 2023) class at a point in the lower 48 United States, and the wildland-urban interface (WUI 2020) class of its census block. Landscape screening information, not a property inspection or coverage determination.

tools.name: get_flood_zone
tools.description: Returns the FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer flood zone at a point in the United States, its subtype and whether it is a Special Flood Hazard Area. Not an official flood zone determination.

tools.name: get_distance_to_coast
tools.description: Returns the straight-line distance in miles from a point to the nearest coastline of the chosen model, and the nearest coast point. undtec-coastal is made for insurance underwriting.

tools.name: decode_vin
tools.description: Decodes a 17-character VIN with the NHTSA vPIC database: year, make, model, trim, body, engine and plant. Missing values mean NHTSA has no data for that field.

tools.name: lookup_fmcsa_carrier
tools.description: Finds a motor carrier by USDOT number (full record: status, safety rating, BASICs, authority, insurance filings, cargo, out-of-service orders), or by MC number or company name (matching carriers). Give exactly one of dot, mc or name.

tools.name: search_insurance_carriers
tools.description: Searches the NAIC registry of US insurance companies, admitted and non-admitted, by name. Abbreviations work. Returns NAIC code, group, state of domicile and premium figures.

tools.name: get_insurance_carrier
tools.description: Returns the NAIC registry record of one US insurance company: name, FEIN, group, status, domicile, address, phone and group market figures.

tools.name: get_surplus_lines_tax_rates
tools.description: Returns a US state's surplus lines premium tax rate, stamping and other fees, payment schedule and legislative source. Regulations change frequently; verify with the state insurance department.
